items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: and myself and Abbie Foster, Chinese we called him, drum player. We went over to Celestad's house and talked Celestad into making up his own band.

ctx.x: But anyway, we thought probably Celestad wasn't getting a right deal, but maybe Ridgely may be in the right, we actually don't know. But before Ridgely died they told me it was just concerning a little money. And it was a terrible mistake that they made because the band was too great. So I took Simon Marrera, John Marrera, and myself and Abbie Foster, Chinese we called him, drum player. We went over to Celestad's house and talked Celestad into making up his own band. And called it Celestad's original Tuxedo band.…
